title: Penthouse Magazine March 2002 Alan Dershowitz Kofi Annan Backyard Wrestling
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Light cover and spine wear, small crease at the front cover's top left corner, crease down the back cover. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Penthouse Magazine, March 2002 - U.S. Edition.

Features in this issue include Alan M. Dershowitz on fighting terror without a police state ("Ashcroft, Take Note!"), UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan's Nobel Prize prescription for peace, backyard wrestling's raging popularity ("Sex, Blood, and Videotape") and "Pimp's Confession."

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Light shelf wear to the glossy cover and spine, a small crease near the top left corner of the front cover, and a crease running down the back cover. Please see the photos for exact condition.
